scripts.dev:app: bun run build:dependencies && concurrently -k -n tools,ai-sdk,next,py -c yellow,magenta,blue,green "bun run --cwd ../../packages/tools dev" "bun run --cwd ../../packages/ai-sdk dev" "next dev --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port ${PORT:-3005}" "bun run dev:python"
scripts.build:dependencies: bun run --cwd ../../packages/tools build && bun run --cwd ../../packages/ai-sdk build
scripts.build: bun run build:dependencies && bun run build:app
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n next,py -c blue,green "next start --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port ${PORT:-3005}" "bun run dev:python"
scripts.check-types: bun run build:dependencies && bun run check-types:app
